summary: Frontend-only verification of Send Rx unsaved-work safeguard. All 6 scenarios PASS: (1) sidebar nav on dirty draft opens shared unsaved-guard-overlay (Cancel/Discard/Save&leave); (2) Save&leave persists per-patient draft to sessionStorage, restore banner (sendrx-restore) appears on same-patient re-select and Restore rehydrates the ZZGuardQA med card; (3) cross-patient safety — a different patient does NOT see the stored draft's restore banner; (4) Change patient opens local sendrx-change-guard (Stay keeps draft, Leave&discard clears patient + wipes stored draft); (5) not-dirty passthrough — sidebar navigates immediately with no modal; (6) successful Send clears dirty (no unsaved modal on next sidebar click, no restore banner on re-select). sessionStorage key confirmed as visita_rx_draft_<patient_ref>.
critical_code_review_comments: SendPrescription.jsx is large but modular; dirty computation + setGuard registration is clean and correctly re-registers on save function/dirty change.
Change-patient uses a separate local modal (correct: same-page action) — good UX distinction from shared cross-route modal.
sessionStorage key visita_rx_draft_<ref> correctly scopes drafts per patient; verified cross-patient isolation.
